QuestInfo.0: You told #b#p1092006##k about #b#p1092012##k, but it just made him angry. Maybe he doesn't like your face.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092012##k mostly seems angry that you don't have enough muscles. He's sent you off to #b#p1092008##k so she can pump you up!
QuestInfo.2: You went to see #b#p1092008##k. She'll whip you into shape in no time!

0.0: How you gonna sail the high seas with a body like that?\r\nTsk, not even a HINT of muscle. Disgraceful! If the cap'n wants you in the crew, fine, but you better see #b#p1092008##k and whip yourself into shape!

yes.0: #b#p1092008##k knows how to get a Pirate in fighting condition. You want to survive on this crew, you listen to everything she tells you. Well, get on to the #r#m120000104##k!

no.0: Giving up, eh? Fine! Get out of here!

1.0: Yes, #b#p1092006##k said you'd be coming. Hm. This is going to be a challenge...

yes.0: You sure you have what it takes? You'll be facing monsters unlike anything you've ever seen.

npc.0: Go straight to the #r#m120000104##k and report to #b#p1092008##k!
